name: Fader control
lesson:
## Smooth over 8, decisive over 1

Bring B's channel fader up evenly across 8 bars, hold 4, down over 4, back up in 2, then off in a single bar. The slow ramps train an even hand; the fast ones train commitment. A fader that stalls halfway is the most common tell of a nervous mix.

Watch the blue path: your live position is the dot on the strike line. Stay inside it.
